episode_title: Lori Ashby: Senior Vice President of Product Management and Experience Enablement at Highmark Health Discusses Commitment to Hiring People with Disabilities within the Organization

real_qa.q: What is the primary responsibility of Highmark Health's Product Management and Experience Enablement team?
real_qa.r: The team's job is to make the healthcare products and experiences of Highmark work better for the people who use them. They focus on ensuring products are showcased in the right way, help customers understand their benefits and plan details, and know how to access care while removing complexity from the products and capabilities offered to members.
real_qa.requete: Highmark Health Product Management team responsibilities

real_qa.q: How many people work in Lori Ashby's division at Highmark Health and what are the main disciplines?
real_qa.r: Ashby's division operates around 200 people on a global scale, with teams across the United States and in India. The organization has two primary disciplines: product management and change management, organized into three distinct teams focusing on insurance and wellness products, capabilities and processes that make products work, and change management to ensure adoption and monitoring.
real_qa.requete: Lori Ashby team size Highmark divisions structure

real_qa.q: What was Highmark Health's recognition for hiring people with disabilities in 2024?
real_qa.r: Highmark Health earned recognition as the best place to work for the 10th year for individuals with disabilities in a survey by the American Association of People with Disabilities and Disability Inn, reflecting the company's commitment to inclusion and diversity in the workforce.
real_qa.requete: Highmark Health best place work disabilities AAPD 10th year

real_qa.q: How did Highmark Health's Product and Experience Enablement function emerge from combining two organizational areas?
real_qa.r: About three years prior to this interview, Highmark decided to double down on a product management approach. Lori's organization, which had been doing large technical capital programs, merged with Tracy Sala's organization that focused on large experiential initiatives. This combination formed the broader Product and Health Experience function.
real_qa.requete: Highmark Health product management Tracy Sala reorganization

real_qa.q: What was the professional impact on a person with disability hired through Bender at Highmark Health?
real_qa.r: An individual hired through the Bender partnership joined Highmark's capability product team focusing on transforming infrastructure and bringing insurance products to market. He earned internal certificates, demonstrated drive for continuous learning in coding technology, and was recently selected as a finalist on one of the top five teams in an internal AI hackathon involving hundreds of participants.
real_qa.requete: Bender Highmark Health disability hiring success AI hackathon

guest.titre: Senior Vice President of Product Management and Experience Enablement
guest.bio_context: Lori Ashby was born and raised in southwestern Pennsylvania outside Washington, PA. She studied at Duquesne University, earning two undergraduate degrees and later a master's degree. She has spent more than 25 years on the business side of healthcare, working across operations, technology, and strategy before moving into product and experience management at Highmark Health.
